info.title: COVID-19 JHU CSSE Universal API
info.description: Historical public COVID-19 case, death, recovery, daily report, location lookup, and correction data from the Johns Hopkins University Center for Systems Science and Engineering GitHub repository. JHU CSSE ceased collecting and reporting this dataset on March 10, 2023, so actions return archived historical data.

get.summary: Get Global Daily Report by Date
get.description: Retrieves global COVID-19 daily report rows for a selected date.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Report date in MM-DD-YYYY format. The archived daily report files are available for dates in the dataset history, with the latest global daily report at 03-09-2023.

schema.description: Report date in MM-DD-YYYY format. The archived daily report files are available for dates in the dataset history, with the latest global daily report at 03-09-2023.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

active.description: Active case count when provided by the source.

admin2.description: County or equivalent local administrative area.

caseFatalityRatio.description: Case fatality ratio reported by the source.

incidentRate.description: Incident rate reported by the source.

provinceState.description: Province or state name when provided.

recovered.description: Recovered count when provided by the source.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: The API key or connection cannot access this action.
